data.body: 35bc validated. Implementer: standard tier (sonnet) subagent, held out from edge/E2E oracle (stashed outside the tree), saw only the happy-path case; reported 1 edit->test cycle. Held-out validation: 12/12 GREEN first pass - implementer satisfied det_floor lockstep, _scope_sections SC-drop, SC-inertness and non-epic regression guards it never saw. No escalation needed. Mutation/teeth check: 3 targeted mutations each killed by a distinct test - (1) revert gates.py repoint -> 5 RED incl. happy path; (2) revert det_floor.py ONLY -> 2 RED, exactly the lockstep cases (the invariant that test exists for); (3) restore '## success criteria' to _SCOPE_HEADINGS -> scope test RED. Restored -> 12 pass. Refactoring litmus: assertions are scores, CLI exit codes and extracted-text content; behavior-preserving edits do not break them. Ticket AC: AC1 no SC in the 3 source files PASS; AC2 the two _clarity_score epic branches byte-identical (diff clean) PASS; AC3 no '## Success Criteria' heading in the named fixture files PASS. Documented exception: the new oracle file tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_criteria_heading_collapse.py necessarily contains the literal heading as its negative-case probe - story 5f4d's reintroduction guard is allowlist-based and its own AC calls for an injection test, so this is anticipated, not a violation. Pre-flight: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (379 files).
